title: Sign in
subtitle: Enter your credentials to access Race Tracker.
errorVerifyEmail: Verify your email before signing in.
errorSignIn: Sign-in could not be completed. Check your credentials and try again.
recoveryCredentialsRequired: Enter your email and password first.
recoveryResult: If your account is eligible, its deletion has been cancelled. You can now sign in.
recoveryError: We could not check the deletion request. Please try again.
unauthorized: This account is not authorized for the requested area.
accessDeniedDescription: Your account does not have access to this area. Redirecting to sign in.
secureLoginNote: Secure login powered by JWT authentication
devCredentialsNote: Development credentials are supplied through the local environment only.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.enrollDescription: Administrators must use two-factor sign-in. Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.enrollFailed: Two-factor setup could not start. Sign in again to retry.
mfa.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They will not be shown again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the email you registered with. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset the password. It expires soon, so open it shortly.
forgotPassword.failed: The link could not be sent. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Use at least {{min}} characters. You'll be signed out of other devices.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.verified: Your email is verified. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.invalid: This verification link is invalid, expired or already used. If you haven't verified yet, enter your email to get a new link.
verifyEmail.resendSent: If that account still needs verifying, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
verifyEmail.resendFailed: The link could not be sent. Please try again.
